row.body: My note from near lunchtime: the field trial crew carried sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that the bridge was blocked.
row.title: Near lunchtime: sealed seed packet

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
